claims.evidence: Witness report identifies only a used car engine; brand and model are null and no Lexus branding is visible.
Report shows no import or used-import status.
Photos cannot show country of origin; no shipping documents in report.
Report explicitly states whether the engine runs or starts is not shown.
Still photos cannot reveal engine knock or internal noise.
Report states mileage is not shown; no odometer visible.
External photos cannot confirm whether the engine was previously disassembled.

risks.risk: Engine does not run or start
risks.proof: Video of the engine cranking and running on a stand

risks.risk: Internal damage or wear such as knock, low compression, or overheating
risks.proof: Compression test video or borescope inspection of cylinders
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown or damaged internals

risks.proof: Service history or donor vehicle odometer reading
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-mileage or unknown age

risks.risk: Missing ECU, mounts, sensors, or full wiring harness
risks.proof: Itemized video showing all included accessories and harness
risks.if_unproven: priced as engine block only without accessories

risks.risk: Not actually a Lexus LX460 engine
risks.proof: Close-up of engine block/VIN and valve cover branding plus documentation
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic used engine

risks.risk: Import origin misrepresented (not tokunbo or not from Belgium)
risks.if_unproven: priced as locally sourced rather than imported

proof_requests: Video of the engine running and a compression test
Close-up photos of engine number, valve cover, and any Lexus badging
Itemized photos of included accessories such as ECU, mounts, and wiring harness
Import or customs documents supporting origin
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a used car engine, so a worst-case price can be set even though condition, identity, and origin are unproven.
